brief: Allocate a windfall among stated urgent obligations and goals without assuming one universal rule.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Unexpected Money"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Da propósito al dinero inesperado"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Dê finalidade ao dinheiro extra"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Allocate a windfall among stated urgent obligations and goals without assuming one universal rule.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A windfall creates choices, not a universal rule; use the stated urgent obligations, goals and priorities to allocate it.
instruction.misconception: Every windfall must be spent, saved or invested in the same way regardless of urgent unpaid obligations.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: List urgent obligations and chosen goals. Allocate received money using the scenario’s priorities; there is no universal formula.
The stated priority directs the first allocation.
Funding the urgent obligation reduces the remaining windfall.
One amount cannot fully fund two separate uses simultaneously.
The goal receives only what remains after both stated allocations.
Unconfirmed money cannot yet fund a definite allocation.
The stated priorities guide this household’s allocation.
